english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for people or things being separate in space or for considering them separately.
Use this as the all-purpose choice when people or things are apart rather than together.

examples.english: The two tables need to be kept apart.
examples.jyutping: loeng5 zoeng1 toi2 jiu3 fan1 hoi1 baai2

examples.english: These two tables need to be placed separately; don’t push them together.
examples.traditional: 呢兩張枱要分開擺，唔好撈埋一齊。
examples.jyutping: ne1 loeng5 zoeng1 toi2 jiu3 fan1 hoi1 baai2 m4 hou2 lou1 maai4 jat1 cai4
